description: Renegotiate a stale system-derived model requirement only when model_task_mismatch is the sole original preflight failure, then require the same real preflight predicate to pass before an optimistic plan update.
preconditions: Owner authorized deployment of source commit 8e7f2c3 and a bounded 40000-token acceptance pass on 2026-08-12.
The independent read-only observer reports on-track before deployment.
R8 snapshot shows zero active experiment runs, attempt reservations, queued/running GPU jobs, compute jobs, Colab requests, and open LLM reservations.
Live agents/experiment_forge.py and meta_harness/preflight_repository.py exactly match source commit 8e7f2c3^; any mismatch stops deployment.
A PostgreSQL custom-format backup and OPERATORS.log BEFORE DEPLOY entry are recorded before any live file is replaced.
No schema, environment, systemd unit, or manual business-table change belongs to this batch.
deployment_steps: Stop deepgraph-auto-advance.timer and deepgraph-auto-advance.service together, then deepgraph-auto-execute.service, deepgraph-observe@10/11.service, and deepgraph-web.service after R8 is zero.
Apply batch 1 through scripts/deploy_manifest_batch.py and verify both deployed SHA256 values.
py_compile both live modules and confirm HTTP 200 plus clean API stats after restart.
Restart web, observers, and auto-execute; keep the normal auto-advance timer stopped while one bounded --agenda 11 pass runs with --spend-limit 40000.
Append every production action, backup path, checksum, restart, health result, and acceptance result to OPERATORS.log.
Do not manually mutate business state; all plan, grant, forge, execution, and OutcomeRecord transitions must use the deployed repository and autonomous entry points.
tests: 18/18 targeted tests passed; full suite 72 failed / 824 passed / 18 skipped / 3 collection errors, matching the pre-change 72-failure and 3-error baseline with six new passes; all six meta-harness audits exit 0.

rollback.order: stop services after R8 zero, then reverse batch 1
steps: Use deploy_manifest_batch.py --rollback for 1-stale-model-renegotiation; both restored files must match their recorded predeployment SHA256 values.
No schema, .env, or systemd unit change is part of this batch, so no secondary rollback is required.
Restart deepgraph-web.service, deepgraph-observe@10/11.service, and deepgraph-auto-execute.service; restore the timer only when the bounded acceptance pass or rollback decision is complete.
Record restored hashes, service states, health results, and any post-deployment autonomous data effects in OPERATORS.log.
rollback.data_impact: The code writes a revised plan only after the replacement passes the same preflight predicate and only through a scoped compare-and-swap. It preserves negotiation history and both original and revised preflight evidence. A code rollback does not erase those auditable autonomous records and requires no manual business-table rewrite.

batches.purpose: Break idea 105's frozen-plan deadlock without weakening preflight or manually editing its business plan.
batches.health_check: Re-hash both targets, py_compile them, confirm GET / returns HTTP 200 and /api/stats contains real numbers without filesystem paths.
batches.acceptance: Both deployed SHA256 values equal the manifest; the original failing preflight remains recorded; only a same-predicate passing replacement can persist; no active attempt crosses the deployment boundary.
